mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand for residential construction, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a weakening labor market, which typically precedes reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), rising consumer price inflation signals potential central bank tightening and reduced real consumption, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which typically precedes weaker corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates persistent inflation, which typically leads to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in retail sales (RSAFS) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a strong economy with tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to fears of an impending recession.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when both RSAFS and FEDFUNDS are rising.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), the S&P 500 typically experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS increases > 0.1% in 3 months.
